question: Delhi first became the capital of a kingdom during the reign of the _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tomara Rajputs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Tomara Rajputs were a significant dynasty in North India, particularly in the region around Delhi.
 
• Delhi first became the capital of a kingdom under the rule of the Tomara Rajputs.
 
• The Tomara dynasty is known for establishing and fortifying the city of Delhi, which later became a prominent center of power.
 
• The reign of the Tomara Rajputs in Delhi marked the beginning of its historical prominence as a capital city.
 
• Delhi's strategic location and the efforts of the Tomara Rajputs laid the foundation for its importance in Indian history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mamluks**

 
 
• The Mamluk dynasty was the first of the Delhi Sultanates, which ruled over Delhi in the early 13th century.
 
• They were originally slave soldiers who rose to power and established their own dynasty.
 
 
 
• **Tuglaqs**
 
 
• The Tughlaq dynasty was a Muslim dynasty that ruled over the Delhi Sultanate in the 14th century.
 
• They are known for their administrative reforms and attempts to expand the empire.
 
 
 
• **Chauhans**
 
 
• The Chauhan dynasty was a Rajput dynasty that ruled parts of northern India before the establishment of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• Prithviraj Chauhan, the most famous ruler of the Chauhan dynasty, is known for his battles against the invading Ghurid forces.
